items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: The interviewee discusses musicians working with bands like the Camellia Band and Excelsior, but does not mention Bill Russell personally or describe any direct interaction.

ctx.x: Well he used to work with all the bands, you know. He'd work in with the Camellia Band, Excelsior, he'd work anywhere. You see that's the way they'd hire the fellas, all in between. It's like how all the fellas, they know how all that's good, they'd get him. You see you have to pick out your best mans to go out on these street parades and things like that. And that's how we worked it.
Bill, did you get who some of the people you heard when he was young? We asked a few.

Yeah, who were some of the bands you heard when you just were getting interested in music? Do you remember the name of some of the bands? When you were quite young, you know, some of the musicians you liked?
